title: pvHyperTreeGridCellCenters
body:
## pvHyperTreeGridCellCenters

Produces a point cloud (polydata) with one point at the centre of each leaf cell of a hyper tree grid; the cell arrays become point arrays on those points. CreateVertexCells (ParaView default true) adds a vertex per point so the points render and count as cells. Use it for glyphs or for sampling HTG data at cell centres; for ordinary meshes use pvCellCenters.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `HyperTreeGridCellCenters`. Identity: `filters/HyperTreeGridCellCenters`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

Accepted data: hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
